description: The drum page's loading planner: how many vehicles of a type (box trailer, curtain-sider, open top, flat rack, containers, platform, rigid truck, or a custom box in full mode) a number of drums needs, by space and by payload, the rows and positions, chocks and bedding, and every vehicle type compared, each vehicle with its sources. Without full and without payment the answer is the verdict a visitor sees on the site, counted against the designs' daily free allowance; full: true (or any paid call) answers in full. input: {vehicle: c20 | c40 | c40hc | ot20 | ot40 | fr20 | fr40 | curtain | mega | flat | lowloader | rigid18 | custom, dt (transport diameter, mm), width (mm), gross (kg per drum), qty, custom?: {L, W, H, payload} (full mode only)}. $0.50 per calculation in USDC with x402; the free verdict counts against the designs' 2 free calls per caller per UTC day; a list of up to 50 items at $0.50 per item, one payment.

full.description: true: the whole answer, a paid call. Without it the free verdict, counted against the designs' daily free allowance.
